overall_summary: Husband-Wife / Married relationship emotional topics drastically outperform all other formats on the channel, generating over 1600+ views per video compared to sub-400 views for generic shayari, sibling, or motivational content.

winning_patterns.evidence: Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar... (1,768 views, 61 likes) and Wife Emotional Video (1,677 views, 50 likes) are the top 2 performing videos by a wide margin.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on post-marriage emotional nuances, daily unseen sacrifices, and unspoken expectations between partners.

winning_patterns.evidence: Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala... reached 390 views, showing secondary interest in relationship compromise and self-respect.
winning_patterns.action: Combine marital dynamics with themes of self-respect and subtle emotional compromises.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic abstract shayari / heavy literary poetry
weak_patterns.evidence: Jis Din Sach Likhunga... received only 20 views and 1 like.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract literary Hindi phrasing; stick to conversational, modern spoken Hindi (Hinglish/Hindi blend).

weak_patterns.evidence: Sister video attempts got 19 views and 139 views across two uploads.
weak_patterns.action: Pause sibling-focused emotional content until core audience built around marriage/relationship dynamics stabilizes.
